name: Teardown the skyscrapers
desc:
🏙️ Welcome to Teardown the Skyscrapers! 💥
Step into a city full of towering buildings — and destroy everything in sight!
Use powerful tools, explosives, and vehicles to tear skyscrapers down piece by piece.
💣 Smash walls, collapse floors, and watch massive structures crumble in real time.

🌆 Features:

Realistic physics destruction 🔩

Explosives, wrecking balls, and more tools 💣

Sandbox freedom — destroy however you want! 🧱

Can you bring the entire skyline down?
🔥 Play now and become the ultimate demolisher! 🔨
